task.goal: Produce a five-frame minimalist typographic carousel in which each slide delivers one complete, self-contained juxtaposed observation, rendered as a single line of undecorated black sans-serif text on a white field with a fixed black dot mark beneath it, with no portrait or photographic subject and no forced narrative order between slides.
task.success_condition: All five frames share one undecorated black-on-white type system and an identically sized, identically placed black dot mark; each line is legible at mobile carousel scale; and each slide reads as one complete, standalone juxtaposed thought that a viewer can absorb without needing to see the slide before or after it.
task.atomic_boundary: One set of 3 to 7 standalone juxtaposed aphoristic lines becomes one N-slide (here 5-slide) text-dominant carousel. No portrait or photographic subject, no animation, no audio, no single-frame SuperVisual, no forced narrative sequence or numbering between slides.

source_expression_moments.description: Ordered list of standalone juxtaposed aphoristic lines, one per carousel slide, each readable independently of slide order.

voice_context.description: Voice and typographic context reference governing rendering decisions across the full slide set.

carousel_frames.description: Ordered array of production-ready image frames comprising the carousel, one per slide, sharing one type system and dot mark.

activative_input.hidden_pressure: The viewer swipes through carousels expecting either a story that resolves or a listicle that stacks up; this one offers neither. Each slide is a complete, independent thought, and stopping after slide one or bailing after slide three must not feel like missing 'the point,' because there is no single cumulative point to miss.
activative_input.stance: Plain-spoken, unhurried, undecorated — each line stands on its own without argument, elaboration, or attribution.
stakes: the set reads as a random inspirational-quote dump instead of a deliberate sequence of complete, self-contained thoughts
one busy, resized, or off-system slide breaks the flat, consistent type treatment that lets each line breathe on its own
identity_urges: recognize a thought worth pausing on
carry one line forward without needing the rest of the set
activative_input.participation_design: The viewer swipes slide to slide, pausing wherever one line lands; there is no required order of consumption and no call-to-action — each frame is a complete stopping point on its own.
activative_input.intended_reaction: The viewer remembers and can repeat at least one individual line without needing to reference the carousel it came from.
activative_input.smallest_useful_commitment: Read one slide fully and let it stand on its own.
wrong_reading_locks: Do not treat the 5 slides as sequential steps of one argument (e.g., numbering them 1→5, or adding 'but' / 'so' connective language) — each line is a standalone juxtaposed observation, not a chaptered narrative, and forcing a read-order defeats the swipe-in-any-order design this format is built on.

Do not attribute the lines to a named speaker, handle, or brand voice, or style them with quotation marks — these are deliberately anonymous, unattributed aphorisms; adding sourcing misrepresents them as quoted speech, which belongs to the quote-card (SuperVisual) format, not this one.

Do not resize, recolor, reposition, or drop the black dot mark on any slide — it is a fixed anchor across the set (same size, same offset beneath the line) that visually unifies otherwise-unrelated one-liners into one carousel; a dot that moves with text length or disappears on any slide breaks the set's continuity signal.

Do not center-justify or box the text, or introduce a background color, texture, photo, or icon behind the line — the format's legibility and stopping power come from one short line floating in generous white space; any added visual decoration competes with and dilutes that emptiness.

Do not vary type size, weight, or leading across slides to imply emphasis or hierarchy between lines — uniform typography across all frames signals that these are equally weighted, independent thoughts, not a build-up toward a climactic final slide.
wrong_reading_locks_meaning: Do not flatten the social contrast into a single generic advice slide -- PRM-HUM-009 requires explicit side-by-side recognition.
Do not assign pre-formed conclusions to the viewer -- EXP-FBK-004 requires active pattern discovery.
